output_text:
name: n8n-code-javascript
description: Write JavaScript code in n8n Code nodes. Use $input/$json/$node, $helpers.httpRequest(), DateTime (Luxon), $jmespath(), and troubleshooting Code node errors / choosing between Code node modes. Template: const items=$input.all(); const processed=items.map(item=>({timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}));
CRITICAL RULES / PROHIBITIONS (verbatim):
1. **Choose "Run Once for All Items" mode** (recommended for most use cases)
2. **Access data**: `$input.all()`, `$input.first()`, or `$input.item`
3. **CRITICAL**: Must return `[{json: {...}}]` format
4. **CRITICAL**: Webhook data is under `$json.body` (not `$json` directly)
5. **Built-ins available**: $helpers
